text:
elaine_cs: FYI — Novalink renewal popped on my radar. During last night's checkout surge they hit ~3x traffic and p95/p99 jumped ~12-18%. We're seeing a few 504s. Customer is nervous and renewal decision in ~6 weeks. Suggest proactive optimization: int4 quant + split routing (critical checkout -> Dedicated pinned model, non-critical -> hosted compact fallback). Propose a 5% canary. Thoughts? :thinking:

sam_se: +1 on canary. Need perf budget and token distribution. Also what's our rollback story if quality regresses?

elaine_cs: Target from customer: p99 <= 400ms for checkout, errors <1%. Typical request size ~250 tokens; ~40% of requests include long context (~1100-1300 tokens). They want low-risk approach.

miguel_ml: int4 will help latency/cost but watch tail quality on long-context cases. Proposed plan:
1) 5% canary for 48h
2) Enable prefix/KV cache for repeated user history to cut cold-prefix costs
3) Prompt-shrink heuristics for requests >1024 tokens (only send truncated context + summary)
4) Add model-quality gating (semantic-sim) at 1% drift threshold
Example canary routing config (for ops):
```json
{
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "canary_duration_hours": 48,
  "routes": [
    {"match": "meta.priority=='checkout'", "target": "dedicated/novalink-v1-int4"},
    {"target": "hosted/novalink-compact"}
  ]
}
```
Notes: KV cache TTL ~24h for session prefixes; set batch window = 5ms for dedicated pool.

deploy-bot: Canary slot available on dedicated pool `ded-ops-3` at 00:30 UTC tonight. Last deck deploy health: pass. :rocket:

sam_se: I'll own the rollback doc + perf test harness. Can someone upload sample request histogram (token lengths + qps by route)? Need to simulate 3x spike locally.

elaine_cs: Uploaded hist + sample payloads to Novalink folder (s3://redwood-cs/novalink/samples/2026-03-22). Scheduled enablement call with Novalink PM and infra at 10:00 PT today. Adding acceptance criteria to the calendar invite.

miguel_ml: I'll add eval hooks to the canary pipeline to compute semantic similarity and response-token delta. Alert if quality drops >1% or if p99 > 420ms during canary. Also propose enabling incremental KV warmup for first 30 minutes.

elaine_cs: Great — action items: Sam: rollback + perf tests; Miguel: canary eval hooks + KV config; Me: run the canary + notify Novalink PM and internal renewal lead. Will post live notes after 2h of canary. :white_check_mark:
